versions.changelog:
- Initial release: provides a complete SOP for short video and talking-head scriptwriting, with a 3-part structure, 5 hook formulas, and 9 quality control rules.
- Targeted for creators/teams needing a reusable, self-check Chinese scriptwriting standard.
- Includes detailed workflow from input material selection to script output and platform adaptation tips.
- Emphasizes manual finalization for summary and promotional sentences, with strict QC checks before output.
- Prioritizes content safety—no automatic publishing of scripts containing personal or unreleased data.
